mapper.sql: select id, tenant_code, tenant_name, user_name, nick_name, user_type, sex, avatar, phonenumber, remark, valid_date, status, created_by, created_date, last_upd_by, last_upd_date from micro_user
mapper.select: select mu.id, mu.tenant_code, mu.tenant_name, mu.user_name, mu.nick_name, mu.user_type, mu.sex, mu.avatar, mu.phonenumber, mu.remark, mu.valid_date, mar.user_status as status, mu.created_by, mu.created_date, mu.last_upd_by, mu.last_upd_date from micro_user mu inner join micro_user_app_re mar on mar.tenant_code = mu.tenant_code and mu.id = mar.user_id where mu.id = #{id} and mar.app_code = #{appCode}

select c.id, c.tenant_code, c.role_code, c.role_name, c.status, c.created_by, c.created_date, c.last_upd_by, c.last_upd_date from micro_user a left join micro_user_role_re b on a.id = b.user_id left join micro_role c on b.role_id = c.id and c.`status` = '0' where a.id = #{userId}

select a.id, a.tenant_code, a.tenant_name, a.user_name, a.nick_name, a.user_type, a.sex, a.avatar, a.phonenumber, a.remark, a.valid_date, e.user_status AS status, c.id cId, c.role_code, c.role_name, c.status cStatus, d.id dId, d.open_id, d.user_id, d.platform_type, d.remark, d.active_flag, e.id eId, e.app_code, e.user_status, e.valid_date appValidDate from micro_user a left join micro_user_role_re b on a.id = b.user_id left join micro_role c on c.id = b.role_id and c.`status` = '0' left join micro_user_platfrom_re d on d.user_id = a.id and d.active_flag = '0' and d.application_sign = #{appSign} left join micro_user_app_re e on a.id = e.user_id and e.app_code = #{appCode}
and a.user_name = #{username} and a.phonenumber = #{phoneNum} and a.id = #{userId} and a.tenant_code = #{tenantCode}

SELECT SUM(t.staffNum) as staffNum, SUM(t.processNum) as processNum, SUM(t.productNum) as productNum FROM (SELECT u.tenant_code, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS staffNum, 0 AS processNum, 0 AS productNum FROM micro_user u INNER JOIN micro_user_role_re re ON u.tenant_code = re.tenant_code AND u.id = re.user_id INNER JOIN micro_role mr ON mr.tenant_code = re.tenant_code AND mr.id = re.role_id AND mr.role_code != '10' GROUP BY u.tenant_code UNION ALL SELECT u.tenant_code, 0 AS staffNum, COUNT (DISTINCT mpc.process_seq) AS processNum, 0 AS productNum FROM micro_user u INNER JOIN micro_process_common mpc ON u.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code GROUP BY u.tenant_code UNION ALL SELECT u.tenant_code, 0 AS staffNum, 0 AS processNum, COUNT (DISTINCT mp.product_seq) AS productNum FROM micro_user u INNER JOIN micro_product mp ON u.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code GROUP BY u.tenant_code) AS t GROUP BY t.tenant_code

pre.user_status = '0' and mr.role_code = #{roleCode} and pre.app_code = #{appCode}
